changelog:
🔐 Admin login now issues a session token, so the password is no longer sent with every request or placed in the event-stream URL.
🔑 First run generates a random admin password, and upgrades rotate any shipped default automatically. Set ADMIN_PASSWORD to choose your own.
🐛 Upstream rate limits are now returned as 429 with a correct Retry-After header instead of a generic 500.
♻️ A failed background model-list refresh no longer takes a healthy account out of rotation.
🔍 The account test now reports stop reason, token counts, credits, and context usage.
⚙️ Added an opt-in lenient stream integrity mode for upstreams that omit trailing metadata.
